notes.en:
• Film borders: 135 / 120 frames and contact strips built from real negative scans, with light leaks and defects; film lightbox HDR
• 3D frames and new templates; choose which subjects pop out of the frame
• My Bodies: custom body name, brand, logo and lens, applied automatically to the bound camera
• HDR export: keeps iPhone HDR (JPG Ultra HDR); new HEIC format for Photos / iCloud
• Grid split; centered info bar layout for portrait photos; platform presets show HDR support
• Fixed: border color reset on launch, reversed template shadows, preset library loss when the file was damaged, and more
notes.zh-Hans:
• 胶片边框：基于真实翻拍底片的 135 / 120 边框与连续条，可加漏光和瑕疵；胶片灯箱 HDR
• 立体相框与新模板；主体出框可选择出框的主体
• 我的机身：自定义机身名、品牌、Logo 和镜头，绑定相机自动套用
• HDR 导出：保留 iPhone HDR（JPG Ultra HDR），新增 HEIC 格式（存回相册、iCloud）
• 九宫格切图；竖图信息条自动居中排版；平台尺寸标注是否支持 HDR
• 修复：启动时边框颜色被重置、带投影模板的投影方向、预设库损坏时丢失等多项问题
